entries.text: Seedance 2.5 frozen time + rewind effect prompt is below   Photorealistic cinematic 1950s American diner, chrome stools, red vinyl, neon glow and checkerboard floor, shot with modern lived-in realism and soft natural window light. Subtle handheld texture, warm practicals, rich period detail, heavy film grain.  0-4s: [Medium Wide] A striking young woman in her early 20s sits alone at the counter, calm and slightly amused, slowly sipping a tall thick milkshake through a straw. Behind her a young waitress in classic uniform approaches with a tray of eggs and bacon in one hand and a full glass coffee pot in the other. An older lady starts rising from a nearby booth.  4-8s: [Dynamic Tracking] The older lady collides hard into the waitress. Tray, plate, eggs, bacon and coffee pot explode upward in chaotic slow motion. Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera immediately begins a smooth continuous orbit around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the girl at the counter keeps moving, completely unfazed.  8-17s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides in a full elegant orbit through the frozen diner. Coffee hangs in mid-air as glassy ribbons and spheres with perfect volume and surface tension. Bacon strips, eggs and the spinning tray float weightlessly. Patrons and waitress remain locked in startled expressions. The girl at the counter takes one slow, deliberate sip, eyes half-lidded, almost bored, while the entire frozen world (except her) begins an elegant reverse: every droplet, every piece of food and every person rewinds smoothly back to the exact starting positions.  17-24s: [Medium Shot] Rewind lands perfectly. Waitress stands balanced again with tray and coffee pot. The girl lifts her eyes, raises two fingers in a small casual gesture and softly calls the waitress by name. The waitress turns toward her just before the older lady begins to stand, completely avoiding the collision. A tiny private smile crosses the girl’s face.  24-30s: [Extreme Close-Up] Hard cut to her face as she takes one last slow sip. Soft knowing smile, eyes almost closed in quiet satisfaction, like she has done this a hundred times. Shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh of the neon diner behind her.  Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.  30 seconds long is the new AI standard! hope you like it

entries.text: Adapting prompts/ideas to different scenarios is a great curiosity/creativity exercise. You never know the magical tangents it gets you on. Here's an adapted prompt from  @oggii_0  's original. Thanks.  Prompt: STYLE: Miniature Tiny-Person FX, photorealistic live-action, cinematic macro photography, ultra-shallow depth of field, warm nostalgic lighting, vintage collectible toy store filled with antique display cabinets, glass showcases, wooden shelves, tin toys, model trains, action figures, porcelain dolls, old clocks, faded posters, and rare collectibles. Ultra-detailed 8K, vertical 9:16, whimsical adventure tone with realistic physics.  DURATION: 15 seconds  SETTING: A massive old-fashioned collectible toy store viewed from the perspective of a tiny 3D samurai girl. Towering glass display cases, giant toy boxes, hanging model airplanes, dusty wooden shelves, brass lamps, antique clocks, and vintage toy packaging create a labyrinth-like world. Golden afternoon sunlight streams through a large front display window.  CHARACTER: One tiny 3D samurai girl (1:15 scale), consistent appearance throughout: stylized collectible-figure aesthetic, detailed samurai armor with red accents, small katana on her back, determined expression, black tied-up hair, same proportions and design in every shot.  00:00–00:03 — Escape From the Display Shelf  The tiny samurai girl springs from her collectible display stand as if coming to life. She sprints across a wooden shelf filled with vintage toy soldiers and leaps between stacked toy boxes. A giant wind-up robot slowly turns its head as she passes.  Camera: Low-angle macro tracking through the shelf.  SFX: Tiny footsteps, wood creaks, ticking clockwork mechanisms. 00:03–00:06 — Clock Pendulum Crossing She jumps onto the swinging pendulum of a giant antique clock and rides it across an aisle gap. At the apex she launches off, landing on a suspended model airplane hanging from the ceiling.  Camera: Dynamic orbit around the pendulum swing.  SFX: Clock ticking, metal chain rattles, rushing air.  00:06–00:09 — Toy Train Chase She lands on a moving vintage toy train circling a display table. Running across the train cars, she dodges miniature cargo crates and uses the locomotive smokestack as a springboard to reach a nearby display cabinet.  Camera: Fast side-tracking macro following the train.  SFX: Toy train clacking, steam hisses, rapid footsteps. 00:09–00:12 — Glass Cabinet Descent  She slides down a dangling price tag attached to a rare collectible figure, then leaps from shelf to shelf inside a towering glass cabinet. Reflections multiply her image as she races toward the sunlit front of the store. Camera: Vertical macro descent transitioning into a tracking shot.  SFX: Sliding paper tag, glass echoes, distant shop ambience.  00:12–00:15 — Window Escape  Reaching the highest display near the storefront window, she sprints along a row of antique toy boxes. Using a tin toy rocket as a launch ramp, she leaps through a small open window panel. The camera follows as she lands safely on the outside ledge, silhouetted against golden sunlight while the toy store glows behind her. Camera: Dramatic pullback from inside the store to outside the window.  SFX: Leap whoosh, wind rush, distant city ambience, triumphant musical swell. VISUAL REQUIREMENTS: Maintain consistent 1:15 miniature scale, photorealistic vintage toy store environment, realistic physics, authentic wood, brass, glass and toy materials, cinematic macro depth of field, warm nostalgic color palette, consistent samurai girl design, no narration, no subtitles, no outfit changes, no scale inconsistencies.

Prompt Share - Time Freeze ⏱️

Super easy to create with GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.5

Prompt 👇

Here's my prompt:

Create an approximately 20-second horizontal 16:9 anime video as ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN SHOT. No cuts, transitions, hidden edits, or montage.

CHARACTER LOCK
Use the supplied character reference sheet as the sole visual authority for the heroine. Every view on the sheet depicts the SAME character. Do not reproduce the reference sheet’s layout, labels, borders, or typography.

Preserve her exact facial identity, body proportions, hairstyle, clothing construction, accessories, and color placement throughout the video.

She is an energetic anime streetwear girl with vivid pink hair gathered into the short high ponytail shown in the reference, layered pink bangs, cyan-blue face-framing tips, and small star-shaped hair clips.

She wears the exact colorful over-ear headphones with cat-ear attachments and circular smiley-face earcups shown in the reference. The cat ears are part of her headphones, not biological ears. Keep the headphones securely on her head throughout.

Preserve her glossy cropped yellow jacket with oversized sleeves, pale holographic hood lining, iridescent panels, zippers, and decorative patches. Underneath, she wears the reference black cropped top with a pixel-heart graphic, black fitted shorts, decorated belt, and pink fingerless gloves.

Preserve her full-length cyan-to-lilac-and-pink gradient tights with pixel patterns and the exact chunky white sneakers with yellow, pink, and purple detailing and sculpted purple soles.

Keep the small black backpack with its pink pixel-alien motif, dangling star and heart charms, and the round smiley-face hip pouch exactly as shown. Preserve their attachment points and scale.

Do not replace her shorts and tights with a skirt. Do not add a visor, magical-girl costume, wand, or flowing ribbons.

STORY PROPS
The only added main prop is a compact retro handheld game console, small enough to fit in one hand, with a lavender-and-cyan shell, physical buttons, and a short wrist strap. Its screen shows simple abstract pixel shapes without readable text.

A thin pastel headphone cable connects one earcup to the handheld console. It hangs with natural slack and remains physically connected throughout the action.

Her round hip pouch contains a few small loose star-shaped acrylic trinkets and four or five instant-photo prints. These are separate from the decorative charms permanently attached to her outfit and backpack.

VISUAL STYLE
Premium Japanese anime with expressive linework, polished cel shading, fluid character animation, and the detailed fashion-illustration aesthetic of the reference.

Emphasize the contrast between her bright yellow jacket, pink hair, black clothing, and cyan-lilac accessories. Render the jacket’s glossy and iridescent surfaces with clean anime highlights.

No photorealism, live-action human, or 3D game-character rendering.

LOCATION
A crowded Shibuya street in Tokyo during a bright summer late afternoon.

Dense pedestrian traffic, storefronts, vending machines, traffic lights, taxis, bicycles, and layered urban architecture establish a lively city.

Warm sunlight catches her pink hair, yellow jacket, holographic trim, and chunky sneakers. Her yellow silhouette remains easy to track against the crowd.

OPENING CAMERA — Y2K ANIME HANDYCAM
The camera feels like an early-2000s MiniDV camcorder operated by a friend running beside her.

Use irregular handheld shake, imperfect framing, slight exposure shifts, subtle highlight bloom, mild chromatic fringing, and gentle tape-era softness. Keep the anime artwork and facial expressions readable.

The opening is spontaneous and energetic, with no polished stabilization.

0–6 SECONDS — RUNNING THROUGH SHIBUYA
The unseen camera operator runs alongside the girl, struggling to keep her between waist-up and full-body framing.

She hurries through the packed sidewalk while holding the small handheld console in one hand. Its wrist strap is not secured around her wrist. The headphone cable hangs loosely between the console and her headphones.

Her ponytail bounces, blue-tipped side strands flick across her cheeks, and oversized yellow sleeves shift with each stride. The backpack and attached charms bounce naturally.

She slips between pedestrians, darts around a bicycle, and sidesteps someone carrying shopping bags. One pedestrian briefly crosses part of the foreground without fully concealing the scene.

Clearly late but still playful, she glances back toward the camera, laughs breathlessly, and calls:

“Hurry! We’re gonna be late!”

She turns forward and speeds up.

6–8 SECONDS — THE ACCIDENT
The camera moves slightly ahead into a front three-quarter angle while maintaining the running handheld motion.

She briefly glances down at the handheld console.

Distracted, she fails to notice a low curb. The thick front sole of her chunky sneaker catches its edge.

Her confident expression instantly becomes wide-eyed shock.

She pitches forward and instinctively reaches out to break her fall. The console slips from her hand and travels a short distance ahead of her, within the slack length of its connected headphone cable.

The movement flips open her loosely fastened hip pouch. Several loose star-shaped trinkets and a few instant-photo prints spill outward.

Her jacket sleeves billow, her ponytail swings forward, and the headphone cable forms a broad curved loop beside her outstretched arm. Her headphones stay firmly in place.

At the exact instant before she reaches the pavement:

TIME STOPS COMPLETELY.

She hangs halfway through the fall, both arms extended, one knee bent beneath her and the other leg trailing behind.

Her startled face, ponytail, jacket folds, backpack charms, and shoelaces are perfectly motionless.

The console hangs just ahead of her hand. The connected headphone cable is suspended in its curved shape. Star trinkets and photographs remain scattered through the surrounding air.

Every pedestrian, bicycle, and vehicle stops at the same instant.

Only the camera moves.

8–17 SECONDS — CONTINUOUS FROZEN-TIME FLIGHT
There is NO transition and NO replacement camera.

From its existing position, the same viewpoint continues moving. Human handheld instability gradually evolves into fast, precise FPV-style flight.

Follow one coherent, continuous route through the frozen scene:

Rise above the girl just far enough to reveal the frozen Shibuya crossing. Pedestrians remain locked mid-step, a taxi is stationary in the intersection, and shopping bags hang motionless.

Immediately descend toward her face. Pass close to her wide eyes, pink bangs, cyan-blue side strands, star hair clips, and cat-ear headphones.

Curve around the outside of one smiley-face earcup, revealing its layered colorful construction. Do not pass through her hair, headphones, or body.

Sweep past her shoulder and along the outside of the yellow sleeve. Show the glossy jacket folds, holographic trim, pink fingerless glove, and outstretched fingertips through changing camera perspective.

Continue briefly past the backpack’s pixel-alien motif and its suspended charms, then bank toward the floating handheld console.

Arc closely around the console to reveal its physical buttons, pastel casing, short wrist strap, and abstract pixel display. The console and screen image remain completely frozen.

Thread through the clear opening formed by the broad curve of the headphone cable, staying safely between the cable and her arm. The cable does not shift or widen for the camera.

Fly between the suspended star trinkets and instant-photo prints, creating strong foreground parallax.

The photos show casual anime snapshots of the same girl at arcades, hanging out with friends, and exploring colorful city streets. No readable captions, logos, or text appear on the photos.

Bank around the final photograph to reveal her full frozen pose again.

Keep the camera path spatially coherent and the important details readable. Do not add extra maneuvers that require teleportation or impossible object intersections.

17–20 SECONDS — RETURN AND TIME RESUMES
Make one fast sweeping arc around the heroine, showing the complete frozen arrangement: her falling pose, bright yellow jacket, suspended console, curved cable, star trinkets, and photographs against the motionless crowd.

Descend to street level and physically return to approximately the same imperfect handheld angle and height used before the freeze.

As soon as the camera reaches that position:

TIME RESUMES.

No flash, transition, glitch, or cut.

Every person and object continues from its exact frozen position.

The girl catches herself with one gloved palm against the pavement and lands awkwardly on one knee without injury.

The console lands beside her, remaining within the slack length of the headphone cable. Her headphones stay on. The star trinkets bounce, and the photographs flutter onto the pavement.

Her ponytail, jacket, and backpack charms settle naturally.

The pedestrians immediately continue walking as though nothing unusual happened.

At the same moment, the precise camera movement becomes shaky human handheld footage again. Her friend instinctively lowers the camera toward her.

Still crouching, she quickly scoops up the console and looks toward the lens. Embarrassment flashes across her face, then turns into a mock-annoyed, playful glare.

She holds up the console and says:

“You saw nothing!”

She immediately reaches for a scattered photograph.

End while the handheld camera is still shaking.

CAMERA CONTINUITY
One viewpoint, one uninterrupted shot, and one continuous spatial path.

No camera teleportation, hidden cuts, lens jumps, full-frame wipes, or transitions concealed by passing objects.

Unrestricted camera flight begins only after time stops. Return physically to the street-level filming position before resuming handheld movement.

FROZEN-TIME RULE
During frozen time, absolutely nothing except the camera may move.

No blinking, breathing, hair movement, fabric flutter, rotating charms, drifting photographs, cable motion, animated console screen, pedestrians, or vehicles.

Use true three-dimensional parallax around stationary subjects. Do not simulate this sequence with a flat freeze-frame zoom.

View-dependent reflections on the glossy jacket may change naturally as the camera moves, but the lighting, clothing geometry, and all objects remain fixed.

CHARACTER AND PROP CONTINUITY
Maintain the exact reference face, pink ponytail, cyan-blue side strands, star clips, cat-ear headphones, yellow jacket, black pixel-heart top, black shorts, gradient pixel tights, pink gloves, sneakers, backpack, and smiley hip pouch.

No duplicate character, extra limbs, wardrobe changes, disappearing accessories, or newly appearing objects.

The headphone cable has one consistent length and remains attached to the same earcup and console throughout. It never clips through her body.

The freeze is an unexplained cinematic event, not a power she activates. No transformation, magical effects, or futuristic interface.

AUDIO
Opening: busy street ambience, running footsteps, breathless dialogue, and light rattling from her accessories.

Frozen time: street sound abruptly drops away, with restrained flight sound emphasizing the moving viewpoint.

Time resumes: the city ambience returns instantly, together with the landing, scattered objects, and her final line.

OVERALL FEEL
Playful Y2K streetwear energy with a spectacular frozen-time detour and an embarrassed comic payoff.

Her yellow jacket, pink hair, cat-ear headphones, and pixel accessories remain the visual anchors throughout the dense Tokyo setting.

No slow motion before the freeze. No montage. No black frames. No magical-girl wand, ribbons, or tennis equipment. No photorealism. No subtitles, promotional overlays, reference-sheet typography, logos, or watermarks.

STORY PROPS
The only added main prop is a compact retro handheld game console, small enough to fit in one hand, with a lavender-and-cyan shell, physical buttons, and a short wrist strap. Its screen shows simple abstract pixel shapes without readable text.

A thin pastel headphone cable connects one earcup to the handheld console. It hangs with natural slack and remains physically connected throughout the action.

Her round hip pouch contains a few small loose star-shaped acrylic trinkets and four or five instant-photo prints. These are separate from the decorative charms permanently attached to her outfit and backpack.

VISUAL STYLE
Premium Japanese anime with expressive linework, polished cel shading, fluid character animation, and the detailed fashion-illustration aesthetic of the reference.

Emphasize the contrast between her bright yellow jacket, pink hair, black clothing, and cyan-lilac accessories. Render the jacket’s glossy and iridescent surfaces with clean anime highlights.

No photorealism, live-action human, or 3D game-character rendering.

LOCATION
A crowded Shibuya street in Tokyo during a bright summer late afternoon.

Dense pedestrian traffic, storefronts, vending machines, traffic lights, taxis, bicycles, and layered urban architecture establish a lively city.

Warm sunlight catches her pink hair, yellow jacket, holographic trim, and chunky sneakers. Her yellow silhouette remains easy to track against the crowd.

OPENING CAMERA — Y2K ANIME HANDYCAM
The camera feels like an early-2000s MiniDV camcorder operated by a friend running beside her.

Use irregular handheld shake, imperfect framing, slight exposure shifts, subtle highlight bloom, mild chromatic fringing, and gentle tape-era softness. Keep the anime artwork and facial expressions readable.

The opening is spontaneous and energetic, with no polished stabilization.

0–6 SECONDS — RUNNING THROUGH SHIBUYA
The unseen camera operator runs alongside the girl, struggling to keep her between waist-up and full-body framing.

She hurries through the packed sidewalk while holding the small handheld console in one hand. Its wrist strap is not secured around her wrist. The headphone cable hangs loosely between the console and her headphones.

Her ponytail bounces, blue-tipped side strands flick across her cheeks, and oversized yellow sleeves shift with each stride. The backpack and attached charms bounce naturally.

She slips between pedestrians, darts around a bicycle, and sidesteps someone carrying shopping bags. One pedestrian briefly crosses part of the foreground without fully concealing the scene.

Clearly late but still playful, she glances back toward the camera, laughs breathlessly, and calls:

She turns forward and speeds up.

She briefly glances down at the handheld console.

Distracted, she fails to notice a low curb. The thick front sole of her chunky sneaker catches its edge.

Her confident expression instantly becomes wide-eyed shock.

She pitches forward and instinctively reaches out to break her fall. The console slips from her hand and travels a short distance ahead of her, within the slack length of its connected headphone cable.

The movement flips open her loosely fastened hip pouch. Several loose star-shaped trinkets and a few instant-photo prints spill outward.

Her jacket sleeves billow, her ponytail swings forward, and the headphone cable forms a broad curved loop beside her outstretched arm. Her headphones stay firmly in place.

TIME STOPS COMPLETELY.

She hangs halfway through the fall, both arms extended, one knee bent beneath her and the other leg trailing behind.

Her startled face, ponytail, jacket folds, backpack charms, and shoelaces are perfectly motionless.

The console hangs just ahead of her hand. The connected headphone cable is suspended in its curved shape. Star trinkets and photographs remain scattered through the surrounding air.

Every pedestrian, bicycle, and vehicle stops at the same instant.

Only the camera moves.

There is NO transition and NO replacement camera.

From its existing position, the same viewpoint continues moving. Human handheld instability gradually evolves into fast, precise FPV-style flight.

Follow one coherent, continuous route through the frozen scene:

Rise above the girl just far enough to reveal the frozen Shibuya crossing. Pedestrians remain locked mid-step, a taxi is stationary in the intersection, and shopping bags hang motionless.

Immediately descend toward her face. Pass close to her wide eyes, pink bangs, cyan-blue side strands, star hair clips, and cat-ear headphones.

Curve around the outside of one smiley-face earcup, revealing its layered colorful construction. Do not pass through her hair, headphones, or body.

Sweep past her shoulder and along the outside of the yellow sleeve. Show the glossy jacket folds, holographic trim, pink fingerless glove, and outstretched fingertips through changing camera perspective.

Continue briefly past the backpack’s pixel-alien motif and its suspended charms, then bank toward the floating handheld console.

Arc closely around the console to reveal its physical buttons, pastel casing, short wrist strap, and abstract pixel display. The console and screen image remain completely frozen.

Thread through the clear opening formed by the broad curve of the headphone cable, staying safely between the cable and her arm. The cable does not shift or widen for the camera.

Fly between the suspended star trinkets and instant-photo prints, creating strong foreground parallax.

The photos show casual anime snapshots of the same girl at arcades, hanging out with friends, and exploring colorful city streets. No readable captions, logos, or text appear on the photos.

Bank around the final photograph to reveal her full frozen pose again.

Keep the camera path spatially coherent and the important details readable. Do not add extra maneuvers that require teleportation or impossible object intersections.

Make one fast sweeping arc around the heroine, showing the complete frozen arrangement: her falling pose, bright yellow jacket, suspended console, curved cable, star trinkets, and photographs against the motionless crowd.

Descend to street level and physically return to approximately the same imperfect handheld angle and height used before the freeze.

As soon as the camera reaches that position:

TIME RESUMES.

No flash, transition, glitch, or cut.

Every person and object continues from its exact frozen position.

The girl catches herself with one gloved palm against the pavement and lands awkwardly on one knee without injury.

The console lands beside her, remaining within the slack length of the headphone cable. Her headphones stay on. The star trinkets bounce, and the photographs flutter onto the pavement.

Her ponytail, jacket, and backpack charms settle naturally.

The pedestrians immediately continue walking as though nothing unusual happened.

At the same moment, the precise camera movement becomes shaky human handheld footage again. Her friend instinctively lowers the camera toward her.

Still crouching, she quickly scoops up the console and looks toward the lens. Embarrassment flashes across her face, then turns into a mock-annoyed, playful glare.

She holds up the console and says:

“You saw nothing!”

She immediately reaches for a scattered photograph.

End while the handheld camera is still shaking.

CAMERA CONTINUITY
One viewpoint, one uninterrupted shot, and one continuous spatial path.

No camera teleportation, hidden cuts, lens jumps, full-frame wipes, or transitions concealed by passing objects.

Unrestricted camera flight begins only after time stops. Return physically to the street-level filming position before resuming handheld movement.

FROZEN-TIME RULE
During frozen time, absolutely nothing except the camera may move.

No blinking, breathing, hair movement, fabric flutter, rotating charms, drifting photographs, cable motion, animated console screen, pedestrians, or vehicles.

Use true three-dimensional parallax around stationary subjects. Do not simulate this sequence with a flat freeze-frame zoom.

View-dependent reflections on the glossy jacket may change naturally as the camera moves, but the lighting, clothing geometry, and all objects remain fixed.

CHARACTER AND PROP CONTINUITY
Maintain the exact reference face, pink ponytail, cyan-blue side strands, star clips, cat-ear headphones, yellow jacket, black pixel-heart top, black shorts, gradient pixel tights, pink gloves, sneakers, backpack, and smiley hip pouch.

The headphone cable has one consistent length and remains attached to the same earcup and console throughout. It never clips through her body.

The freeze is an unexplained cinematic event, not a power she activates. No transformation, magical effects, or futuristic interface.

Frozen time: street sound abruptly drops away, with restrained flight sound emphasizing the moving viewpoint.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt Drop

I'm sharing the prompts for this video and my previous two videos below.

The effect is called the frame-break effect. The character overlaps the black bars at the top and bottom, creating the illusion of popping out of the screen. I tried it with Seedance 2.0 before but never quite got the result I wanted, so I decided to give it another shot with Seedance 2.5.

Getting the bar sizes right is still tricky. The model seems to decide for itself. I tried specifying percentages, but the proportions still varied between generations. Camera movement can also make the bars move or change shape, while stronger instructions to keep them fixed can sometimes break the pop-out effect itself.

I'd like to experiment more but this feels good enough to share, and I don't want to burn through more credits. 😅

If you try these prompts, remember to customize them for your own characters. And if you find a better way to control the effect, please share it with me too!

Thanks for all the interest!

Prompt for the first one:

Use @[char ref]￼as the exact character and style reference. Preserve her white hair, red eyes, oversized black cropped top, long cream skirt with orange lining, bare feet and single slender sword. Keep the same angular painterly anime rendering.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL: an unmistakable OUT-OF-FRAME, POP-OUT effect. The character repeatedly projects beyond the central picture window, with her sword, hands, hair and especially her wide skirt visibly moving OVER the black letterbox bars toward the viewer.

COMPOSITING ORDER, BACK TO FRONT:
1. Background and scene.
2. Two broad black letterbox bars at the top and bottom.
3. The foreground character, including her sword, hair and flowing skirt.

The background is confined to the central picture window. The foreground character is NOT confined to that window. Her silhouette continues uninterrupted across its boundaries and onto the black bars. Cream fabric, orange lining, white hair and the silver blade remain fully visible when overlapping black.

Keep both bars equal in thickness and fixed in screen position throughout. The character covers them temporarily without moving or changing them. Keep sections of black visible beside each overlap so the frame-break illusion remains clear.

The camera stays stationary with a fixed wide-angle lens. The character moves rapidly through depth, creating extreme foreshortening and dramatic scale changes through physical approaches and retreats.

OPENING:
Start immediately with a powerful forward lunge. Her sword hand projects toward the lens and overlaps the lower black bar. At the same time, the nearest cream skirt folds spill across that bar. Establish the frame-break effect clearly in the very first movement.

CHOREOGRAPHY:
She pulls back into the central window, then snaps into a fast turning advance. Her skirt fans outward in a huge cream sweep, crossing the bottom boundary and spreading over the black surface. The orange lining flips into view along the moving hem. Her waist and torso remain inside the central window while the nearest fabric extends outside it.

Reverse the rotation sharply into an upward sword flourish. The blade crosses onto the upper black bar, followed by flying strands of white hair. She immediately drives forward again, bringing her hand and blade extremely close to the viewer.

Chain rapid fencing lunges, spinning evasions, low sweeping turns and short twisting leaps. Repeatedly move from the depth of the central scene into extreme foreground space. Alternate sword-and-hair overlaps across the upper bar with large skirt-and-hand overlaps across the lower bar.

Give the skirt substantial momentum: it follows her hips, overtakes her during abrupt stops and lashes around her during reversals. Show broad cream folds sweeping across black, not merely touching the border. Keep the fabric naturally attached to her waist.

Include a close spinning pass where the skirt occupies a large portion of the lower black bar while her sword cuts diagonally across the upper bar. Her face remains readable between them.

FINISH:
A final explosive lunge brings the sword toward the lens as the skirt billows across the lower bar. Resolve into a confident fencing pose with the blade and cream hem still visibly extending beyond the central picture window.

Prioritize visible foreground overlap throughout. Do not crop the entire character inside the letterbox window. Do not replace the effect with simple zooming or a character moving behind black bars.

Fast, forceful motion with crisp silhouettes and brief directional smears. No slow motion, camera movement, duplicated weapons, cloth morphing, text or background music.

---

Prompt for the second one:

Use @[char ref]￼as the exact reference for the character and visual style. Preserve her blonde hair, small crown, orange puff-sleeved dress, cream skirt panels, slender sword and elongated proportions. Maintain the same flat painterly anime aesthetic, rough ink contours, dry-brush textures, graphic silhouettes and restricted orange, cream, yellow and charcoal palette.

Create an explosive, high-speed sword performance built around a strong FRAME-BREAK EFFECT. Solid black horizontal bars occupy the top and bottom 15% of the output throughout the entire shot. These bars remain perfectly fixed to the screen while the camera moves inside the central image window.

CRITICAL COMPOSITING RULE: the environment stays behind the black bars. Selected foreground parts of the character render IN FRONT OF the bars, visibly covering their black surface with her original colors. Her sword, hands, crown, hair and flaring skirt repeatedly cross the inner edges and overlap the bars. Do not crop these foreground elements at the inner frame boundary. The bars remain intact beneath them. This must read as the character physically bursting out of the framed image toward the viewer.

Start immediately in motion. She launches straight toward the lens and thrusts her sword past it, the sharply foreshortened blade growing enormous in the foreground and extending across the lower black bar. The camera recoils and banks sideways as her hand and orange sleeve sweep through the same foreground space.

She snaps into a full-body corkscrew turn, pulling the sword around her waist before whipping it upward. The blade crosses the upper black bar, followed by her crown and flying blonde hair. Her cream-and-orange skirt fans outward in a huge rotating arc, spilling over the lower bar while her torso remains inside the central window.

Chain rapid thrusts, reverse-grip transitions, overhead cuts and tight spinning combinations without pauses. Alternate deep retreats into the scene with sudden lunges directly toward the viewer. Every return creates a new frame-breaking overlap: a sword tip punching toward the lens, a hand reaching beyond the lower border, an orange sleeve flashing across the upper border, a cream skirt panel sweeping across the bottom.

Use aggressive wide-angle perspective and dramatic changes in depth. The camera darts backward ahead of her charge, arcs close around her sword arm, drops below an airborne turn and whips back toward her face. Keep the camera reactive and fluid in one continuous shot. No top-down angles. Keep the black bars screen-locked during every camera roll, orbit and recoil.

Make each near-lens pass feel dangerously close, with strong parallax, brief directional smears and crisp readable silhouettes at the peak of each movement. Her face stays consistent and expressive: fierce concentration with a confident, playful edge. Hair, sleeves and layered skirt react sharply to acceleration.

Finish with one final forward burst. She drives the sword diagonally past the lens, its blade spanning the lower black bar while her crown overlaps the upper bar. Resolve directly into a striking extended fencing pose, close to the viewer, with fabric still whipping around her.

Full-speed action throughout. No slow motion, frozen midair poses or gentle floating. No extra weapons, duplicated limbs, costume changes or transformation into 3D. Sword whooshes, sharp fabric snaps and forceful air rushes only. No background music, dialogue or text.

---

Prompt for this one:

Use @[char ref]￼as the exact character and style reference. Preserve her black hair and braids, oversized blue hooded jacket with cream graphics and orange trim, white cropped top, layered cream-and-orange pants, orange ribbons and white sneakers with black stripes and orange panels. Preserve her single sword with its black wrapped handle, gold guard and red tassel. Keep the same angular painterly anime rendering and blue background.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL:
An unmistakable OUT-OF-FRAME, POP-OUT effect. The character repeatedly projects beyond the central picture window, with her sword, hands, sneakers, hair and loose clothing visibly moving OVER the black letterbox bars toward the viewer.

COMPOSITING ORDER, BACK TO FRONT:
1. Background and scene.
2. Two broad black letterbox bars at the top and bottom.
3. The foreground character, including her sword, hands, sneakers and clothing.

The background is confined to the central picture window. The foreground character is NOT confined to that window. Her silhouette continues uninterrupted across its boundaries and onto the black bars. Blue sleeves, cream fabric, orange panels, sneakers and the silver blade remain fully visible when overlapping black.

STATIC BARS, MOVING CHARACTER:
Both bars are completely static screen graphics. Keep their equal thickness, full width and exact screen position unchanged throughout. Their inner boundaries remain perfectly straight and horizontal.

The character simply renders in front of them. Her movement temporarily hides portions of their black surface. The underlying bars never move or deform. Visible edge segments on either side of an overlap remain aligned on the same horizontal line. When she withdraws a limb, reveal the original unchanged black bar beneath it.

Keep black visible beside the overlapping body parts. No bending, sliding, shaking, stretching, opening or impact reactions in the bars.

The camera stays stationary with a fixed wide-angle lens. One continuous shot. She stays close and large in the composition, using short forward approaches, lateral pivots and compact recoveries. Never retreat deep into the background.

OPENING:
Already close to the viewer, she reaches toward the lens with her EMPTY hand while retaining the sword in her other hand.

Her fingertips visibly overlap the upper black bar. She makes one brisk diagonal lens-wiping gesture with her open palm, passing across the center and over the lower black bar. The hand and sleeve appear in front of both bars during the gesture. The bars remain unchanged beneath them.

The instant her palm clears the lens, she snaps into fast action without a pause.

CHOREOGRAPHY:
A diagonal sword slash passes close to the lens and visibly extends over the upper black bar. Reverse immediately into a tight turning cut. Her blue sleeve and loose cream-and-orange fabric sweep across the lower black surface.

She chambers a knee and fires a sharp FRONT KICK toward the viewer. The sneaker sole becomes large in the foreground and clearly overlaps the lower black bar, with black still visible beside it. Her shin connects continuously back to her body inside the central window. Retract immediately.

Plant the foot and pivot into a fast sword flourish crossing the upper bar. Continue into a compact SPINNING HEEL KICK. The sneaker sweeps close past the lens, its heel and sole projecting over the lower bar while her jacket and trouser fabric trail behind.

Keep alternating clear close-range overlaps: sword above the upper bar, sneaker over the lower bar, empty hand across a border, blue sleeve and cream fabric sweeping across black. Use fast connected combinations with crisp readable extensions and immediate recoveries.

Her clothing follows

I first found this idea on Reddit (tracked it to X) and tried to replicate it using Omni in Google Gemini and Google Flow 😀

Hot video prompt in comment 🌶️
Try my prompt with other insects

AI just generated a mountain sized ice titan tearing out of a glacier

one prompt on Seedance 2.0.. prompt below 👇

SCENE CONTEXT
RIMEBORN. In a frozen valley of an original ice-fantasy world, a mountain-sized titan of layered ice and stone tears itself free from a millennia-old glacier as an army of armored wardens scrambles across the frozen field below, a war-horn ripping across the plain. Timed multishot, five hard cuts across 10 seconds, one shared valley, one titan, one army throughout.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@titan
: mountain-sized ice-and-stone colossus, humanoid silhouette, body built of fractured basalt slabs seamed by ancient blue ice, ice-plated shoulders and back crusted a meter thick with hoarfrost, joints and eye-sockets and rib-seams glowing with pale-cyan runes carved deep into the stone. Original design. 100% matches the reference.
@wardens
: armored foot-soldiers in weathered dark steel plate over black padded gambesons, snow-crusted fur mantles at the shoulders, long spears and rimed shields, no faction crest or logo. Original design. 100% matches the reference.
@warhorn
: a curled black bone horn as long as a warden is tall, bound in leather and iron rings, held at chest height by a single horn-bearer.
STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not a fixed keyframe; model extends the world freely, never reproduced 1:1.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: fractured glacier surface, blue-ice slabs shot through with dark grit, powder snow drifting sideways at 20 km/h. Midground: the wardens crossing the field 200 meters below the titan, tiny against the scale, spears and shields catching the flat light. Background: the glacier wall itself, kilometers of vertical ice cracking apart around the emerging titan, snow plumes rising several hundred meters into a leaden overcast sky. Camera moves along a chest-height and then rising line down the valley floor, always with the titan camera-right or dead-center.

SCALE LOCK
@titan
stands as tall as roughly two hundred wardens stacked head to toe. A single warden reads as a fingernail against the titan's shin in the establishing wide. Ice slabs shearing off the titan's shoulder each read as wide as ten wardens laid head to toe. The size gap holds identical every frame.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Non-empty opening frame:
@titan
is already mid-tear-out, right arm already ripping free from the glacier wall with a sheet of ice already fracturing off the shoulder,
@wardens
already running across the ice below, the horn-bearer already lifting
@warhorn
. Nothing is frozen, everything is already in motion. Rule of thirds: the titan held on the right two-thirds vertical, the horizon line on the lower third, wardens on the lower left third.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, exactly FOUR HARD CUTS at 2.5s, 4.5s, 6.5s, 8.0s. The camera does not cut on its own; cuts only at the specified points.
0.0s to 2.5s — CUT 1, real time
2.5s HARD CUT
2.5s to 4.5s — CUT 2, real time
4.5s HARD CUT
4.5s to 6.5s — CUT 3, real time
6.5s HARD CUT
6.5s to 8.0s — CUT 4, real time
8.0s HARD CUT
8.0s to 10.0s — CUT 5, real time

OPTICS

CUT 3: WS at 63° FOV low across the crevasse rim as wardens dive clear. CUT 4: MCU at 29° FOV on the horn-bearer, horn lifted to lips. @titan
tears its right arm and shoulder free from the glacier wall, basalt-and-ice mass grinding against ice, a wall of powder snow erupting behind it hundreds of meters high;
@wardens

@titan

@wardens
dive clear as a crevasse collapses under them, two soldiers throwing themselves flat and rolling as the ice gives way, spears skittering across the surface, powder snow plumes rising vertical. Camera: low-angle handheld, wardens leaping over the lens, shake violent on the collapse.

@warhorn
to their lips and blows one long note, chest visibly expanding, breath fogging in the cold, the sound carrying across the field as other wardens turn their heads toward it. Camera: tight handheld, presses in 30 cm as the note sounds.

@titan
pulls its full torso free of the glacier wall, the whole glacier splintering apart around it in a cascade of fracturing ice, runes along both arms and the ribcage flaring bright cyan at once, snow erupting in vast vertical plumes across the entire valley. @titan
performs with geological slowness and crushing weight — every movement loaded before it lands, joints grinding stone on stone, no theatrical flourish.

read as terrified working soldiers, not heroes: eyes wide, mouths open, breath fogging hard, one soldier stumbling and being pulled up by another mid-cut. The horn-bearer reads as steady and old, jaw set, eyes tracking the titan. Restrained and human across the army, never cartoonish. Top-tier cinematic restraint.

Mass and inertia carry through every movement of
@titan

Snow plumes obey the crosswind vector at 20 km/h and shear leftward across the valley. Wardens have real body weight — diving bodies land hard, not softly, and slide on the ice with correct friction. WB locked 6500K cold overcast daylight, flat and even, sun fully occluded by leaden cloud. Key is a broad diffuse top-light with no direct sun. The only emitted light in the world is the pale-cyan 5500K rune glow along
@titan
's joints, eye-sockets, and rib-seams, which spills onto the surrounding hoarfrost and briefly reflects in the wardens' plate on close cuts. Camera on the shadow side of the titan across all wide cuts. Faint atmospheric haze at 30% at the glacier wall, thickening into the snow plumes.

Stark white in the snow and powder, frozen blue in the deep ice seams, near-black in the fractured basalt of the titan's core, leaden grey in the sky; every cold tone comes from real material and light bounce, not a filter. Rune cyan lives only in the carved channels — joints, eye-sockets, ribcage seams — and its spill onto immediate hoarfrost. Warden plate reads as dark weathered steel with cold reflections. Blacks stay open with detail in the basalt, highlights roll off in the snow. Color tied to source and surface, not a flat list.

WARDROBE
@wardens
wear weathered dark steel plate over black padded gambesons, snow-crusted fur mantles at the shoulders, iron-rimmed shields, cold-numbed hands in gloves. Fur crusted with ice at the seams. No faction crest, no logo. The horn-bearer wears the same but with a heavier fur mantle and a leather baldric holding
@warhorn
.

AUDIO
NO MUSIC. SFX ONLY — diegetic sound and live audio throughout. No score, no soundtrack, no background music of any kind. CUT 1: sub-bass glacier groaning, ice cracking in long tearing sheets, wardens' plate rattling and boots crunching on ice, wind at 20 km/h. CUT 2: massive stone-on-ice grind, slabs shattering as they hit the glacier floor, rune flare with a low harmonic hum. CUT 3: sharp ice crack, powder snow whumphs, wardens' shouts and grunts, one spear clattering on ice. CUT 4: the horn's long low note, one held bass tone spreading across the valley, warden breath fogging audibly. CUT 5: a full-body glacier splintering roar, layered ice-shear, one titanic bass groan from
@titan
itself. No dialogue, no subtitles.

STYLE
8K photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Naturalistic master cinematography, fine film grain, 35mm film character, crushing primordial-scale epic look, hyperdetailed ice, snow, hoarfrost, basalt, weathered steel.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
10 seconds, five cuts, 16:9, 8K ultra-high-definition, 24 fps, real-time throughout, anamorphic flare character on rune spill.

POSITIVE LOCKS
One shared valley, one
@titan
, same
@wardens
and
@warhorn
across all five cuts, identical every frame, no morphing, no drift.
@titan
stays mountain-sized against the wardens throughout — the scale relationship holds exactly: 200 wardens tall in every wide, one warden a fingernail against the shin. Runes stay pale cyan and stay carved into the stone, they do not migrate. Handheld shake spikes on every titan movement and every ice collapse, never smooths out. Camera stays third-person outside the army throughout the 10 seconds. Warden eyes stay natural — no eye glow; the only emitted light in the world is
@titan
's runes. Contact shadows read clearly where titan meets glacier and warden meets ice. Ice slabs fall with mass, never floating. Snow travels on one consistent wind vector. Clean frame throughout — no logos, no UI, no text overlays, no subtitles, no watermark, no dragons or unrelated creatures in shot.

entries.text: Prompt : Create a 20-second absolutely breathtaking, ultra-photorealistic cinematic disaster sequence beginning on an ordinary busy city street and ending with a GODLIKE AERIAL VIEW of an entire coastal megacity being consumed by multiple simultaneous apocalyptic catastrophes. CAMERA CONCEPT: ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS ASCENDING SHOT. The camera must rise HIGHER AND HIGHER throughout the entire 20 seconds, never descending, never cutting, never teleporting. Begin inches above street level and progressively accelerate upward through rooftop height, skyscraper height, helicopter altitude, and finally an extraordinary multi-kilometer-high panoramic view. During the ascent, perform fast spiraling orbits, aggressive upward corkscrews, sweeping rotations, and dramatic upward pullbacks. Every increase in altitude must reveal an unexpectedly larger scale of destruction. The higher the camera climbs, the more terrifying the disaster becomes. 0-3 sec: EVERYDAY LIFE EXPLODES. Begin with the camera inches above a steaming coffee cup at a busy outdoor cafe on a beautiful sunny morning. A yellow taxi drives past as commuters cross the street. Suddenly, the ground violently shakes and an enormous underground explosion rips the road open. Cars bounce upward, cafe umbrellas fly, windows shatter, and a gigantic crack races down the boulevard. The camera instantly rockets upward past the taxi, twisting between falling signs and exploding shopfronts. 3-6 sec: THE NEIGHBORHOOD COLLAPSES. The camera continues rising in an aggressive spiraling orbit around the surrounding buildings. An elevated commuter train suddenly derails, its carriages crashing through an office facade. A parking garage collapses floor by floor. Enormous sinkholes swallow intersections, water mains explode into towering geysers, and a giant construction crane falls through an apartment building. The entire neighborhood is disintegrating beneath the ascending camera, revealing destruction spreading across multiple streets. 6-9 sec: THE SKYSCRAPER DISTRICT FALLS. Now hundreds of meters above the ground, the camera accelerates upward in a spectacular rotating aerial pullback. An entire downtown skyline comes into view. Suddenly, a huge glass skyscraper begins tipping into its neighbor, triggering a catastrophic chain reaction of collapsing towers. A massive industrial explosion erupts near the waterfront, sending an enormous orange fireball above the rooftops. Elevated highways fracture, bridges snap, and giant clouds of concrete dust expand through the city like shockwaves. Countless smaller explosions flicker across the urban landscape. 9-12 sec: THE CITY REVEALS ITS NEXT NIGHTMARE. The camera spirals higher, now looking down across dozens of city districts. Suddenly, an immense wall of floodwater bursts through the riverfront, swallowing entire neighborhoods and sweeping vehicles off elevated roads. The camera accelerates vertically through drifting clouds, maintaining a dramatic downward angle as the entire city becomes visible beneath it. Without warning, a COLOSSAL TSUNAMI rises beyond the harbor, towering above the coastal skyscrapers. Container ships overturn, suspension bridges begin collapsing, and an enormous wall of white water slams into the waterfront. Far inland, a mountain reservoir dam breaks apart, sending another gigantic flood surging through the valley toward the city. Multiple enormous disasters are now visibly converging from opposite directions. 15-18 sec: THE ENTIRE REGION IS DYING. Entire skyscraper districts are collapsing beneath expanding brown dust clouds. Giant orange industrial fireballs erupt across the outskirts. A colossal tornado moves through the airport district. The tsunami races inland, leaving white foaming destruction along the coast. Rivers overflow into the suburbs, highways break apart like thin ribbons, and enormous wildfire fronts burn across the distant hills. Suddenly, a towering volcanic eruption bursts from a distant mountain, sending a monstrous ash column and branching lightning across the horizon. 18-20 sec: ABSOLUTELY MIND-BLOWING GRAND FINALE. A volcanic eruption illuminates the mountains with orange fire and gigantic ash clouds. Floodwater consumes the suburbs. Industrial explosions erupt across multiple districts. Bridges collapse into the sea. Gigantic dust plumes spread across the landscape while thousands of tiny fires flicker throughout the city. The camera continues ascending as the catastrophic landscape grows smaller, finally revealing the breathtaking, terrifying scale of an entire metropolitan region being destroyed simultaneously. End on an extraordinary, crystal-clear, high-altitude panoramic view of the apocalyptic devastation, with multiple enormous disasters still visibly moving and expanding below. VISUAL STYLE: Ultra-photorealistic $300 -million Hollywood disaster blockbuster, IMAX 70mm scale, breathtaking city-wide destruction, extremely detailed urban geography, spectacular cascading building collapses, realistic flood and tsunami simulations, enormous rotating tornado systems, terrifying volcanic eruptions, volumetric smoke, cinematic sunlight piercing dust and ash clouds, detailed miniature-like city appearance at high altitude, realistic atmospheric perspective, dramatic cloud shadows, extraordinary depth and scale. CAMERA PRIORITY: CONTINUOUS ASCENT ABOVE ALL ELSE. Every second must increase the camera's altitude and reveal more of the surrounding world. Begin intimate and chaotic, progressively transform into enormous aerial devastation, then finish with an unforgettable regional-scale apocalypse. Make the rising camera feel like an unstoppable rocket-mounted cinema camera with smooth but rapid rotational movement. Never reset camera position. No cuts, no fades, no transitions, no time jumps, no descending camera movements, no static compositions. 4K, 16:9, 20 seconds, one continuous unbroken ascending shot, maximum disaster scale, relentless visual escalation.

Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, photorealistic handheld phone video shot from inside an open-door helicopter hovering over an active volcanic lava lake. Bright sunny day, hard daylight, blue sky, black lava fields. One continuous take. Same camera, same crater, same lava surface the whole time.

@/image is the ONLY identity of the person. Keep the exact same face, skin, hair, age, body and facial features as @/image for the whole clip. Do not change the person. Do not generate a different face.

Outfit override only: black flight suit, black gloves, aviation headset. Identity stays @/image.

NO DIALOGUE. The person does not talk at any moment. Mouth stays closed. No lip-sync. No speech. No TTS. No generated voice. No narrator.

SPATIAL LOCK:
The kernels fall onto ONE exact point on the lava, slightly left of frame center, next to the helicopter floor edge.
That impact point is marked by a brown kernel stain.
The first white popcorn, the growing dome, the geyser and the explosion MUST all come from THAT SAME stain.
Do not start the eruption from another spot. Do not move the crater. Do not cut. Do not reset the lava. Same impact point from 7.5s to 15.0s.

Strict timing. Do not stretch any beat. Do not linger on the lava.

0.0-2.0s: Medium shot of the person from @/image sitting in the open helicopter doorway, holding a large bright-red plastic bucket filled to the brim with unpopped yellow corn kernels. Looks straight at camera, lifts the bucket a little toward lens then gives one clear confident nod. Mouth closed the whole time. No talking.

2.0-3.0s: Turns toward the open door and starts pouring immediately.

3.0-7.5s: Dumps the entire bucket. A thick continuous stream of yellow unpopped kernels falls toward ONE fixed point on the glowing orange-red lava lake. Camera tilts down following that same stream. Helicopter floor and door edge stay in frame as a spatial anchor. Keep pouring the whole time onto that same point.

7.5-8.0s: The kernels HIT that exact point. Clear impact. A brown stain of kernels sits on the lava at that point.

8.0-10.0s: ONLY a 2-second wait. Camera stays locked on that same brown stain. No popcorn yet. Do not hold longer than 2 seconds. Do not pan to another part of the crater.

10.0s EXACT: the first white popped kernel appears FROM THE SAME BROWN STAIN, not from anywhere else.

10.0-12.0s: A white popcorn dome grows fast OUT OF THAT SAME STAIN.

12.0-13.5s: A massive popcorn geyser shoots straight up toward camera FROM THAT SAME POINT.

13.5-15.0s: Popcorn slams into the helicopter doorway and floods the cabin and the lens. Same person from @/image still in the scene. End on chaos filling the frame. Handheld shake.

Critical:
- Popcorn MUST start erupting at 10 seconds, not later.
- Eruption origin = kernel impact point. Same coordinates. Same stain.
- No second crater. No second splash. No eruption from the far side of the lava.

Audio: helicopter rotor, wind, pouring kernels, lava hiss, popcorn burst only. No music. No voice. No narrator. No English. No Spanish. No text, logos or watermark.

今回は事前イメージをリファンスした状態でもかっこいい感じに変形してくれました。
日本語でプロンプトを書いたせいかちゃんと富士山へと飛翔していたのは圧巻。

映像は運転席内から始まる。

カメラは運転席の左前から男性を斜めに捉えている。

デコトラは画像3の山道を猛スピードで下っている。

男性は真剣な表情で荒々しくハンドルを操作し、体を揺らしながら力強く運転している。

フロントバンパーは巨大な下あごへ変形する。

ルーフ上の電飾は後方へ伸び、長い首を形成する。

荷台は数千もの細かなメカパーツへ分解され、胴体、肩、腕、尻尾へ精密に変形していく。

タイヤは肩、肘、腰、膝、足首などの関節へ変形する。

ドラゴンの両目が強く発光し、大きく咆哮する。

そのまま道路から力強く飛び立つ。

飛び立つ瞬間、前方には画像3と同じ山道の急カーブが見えており、ドラゴンはそのカーブへ進入する直前で道路を離れ、空へ向かって勢いよく舞い上がる。

entries.text:
Watch Venice become a sphere

Seedance 2.5 on
@FishCreativeHQ

Prompt

[Image 1](image_1) is the face and identity reference. A young Korean woman in her early twenties with EXACTLY the face of @[Image 1](image_1) — same facial structure, same features, natural Korean skin, no glasses. Long pastel pink hair, wearing a 1940s teal-orange wool coat-dress with white collar, a brown leather satchel worn cross-body, grey knee socks, black leather shoes, holding a folded yellow envelope. Every shot of her matches @[Image 1](image_1).
1940s Venice at golden hour. Amber and teal cinematic grade, anamorphic 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, volumetric god rays, fine film grain. Inception-style folding architecture — the Venetian city curls upward and hangs inverted overhead like a mirrored ceiling. The woman always stays under normal gravity while the world folds around her. Continuous camera motion, no hard cuts.
[TIMELINE PROMPT]
0–3s: Lateral tracking shot along a stone quay by the Grand Canal at sunset. The young woman @[Image 1](image_1) in a teal coat sprints past camera, clutching a yellow envelope. Above her the entire city hangs upside down, mirrored — a man in a bowler hat walks a dachshund across the inverted street. A red umbrella drifts weightlessly between the two worlds. Pigeons scatter through the amber light.
3–6s: Camera follows behind her into a narrow Venetian alley, dry leaves swirling in her wake. At the far end the street peels upward into the sky, buildings stacking vertically like a wall of windows. Her footsteps echo between the stone walls.
6–9s: The camera slowly rolls 90 degrees. The alley wall becomes the ground beneath her feet; she keeps running, unfazed. The roll continues into a wide orbit as she races up a floating spiral stone staircase suspended in mid-air, fragments of terracotta Venetian rooftops rotating around her like a kaleidoscope.
9–12s: Extreme wide silhouette. She runs across the top of an arched stone bridge over a wide canal against the blazing setting sun. The mirrored city hangs both above and below the arch. On the inverted plane, a lone pedestrian walks the opposite direction. Birds burst across the frame in slow motion.
12–15s: Low angle looking straight up between two towering building walls, the sky a thin bright strip. She leaps across the vertical chasm, arms spread wide, coat and hair flying, satchel swinging. Camera holds on her against the sky. Wind roars.
15–18s: Handheld push-in through a crowded 1940s Rialto market street — vendors stacking crates of apples, laundry strung overhead between the buildings. She weaves between blurred foreground shoppers, running away from camera. An apple rolls loose across the cobblestones.
18–21s: Camera tilts up a grand brick bell tower — a Venetian campanile — as the surrounding city folds and curls around it. The woman appears tiny on the tower ledge, pauses against the sun, then steps off toward the rooftops. Bells begin to ring.
21–24s: Rooftop terrace garden framed by a rose-covered arbor. An elderly woman in a grey cardigan waters a bed of vivid flowers with a tin can. Behind her, Venice and the domes of St Mark's Basilica glow at sunset over the lagoon while the inverted city hangs overhead. The young woman balances along the stone balustrade, arms out, then jumps down onto the terrace.
24–27s: She holds out the yellow envelope. The old woman turns, sets down the watering can, and takes it. Both smile warmly at each other. Rose petals drift upward past them, falling toward the inverted sky.
27–30s: Camera pulls back and rises fast. The whole city folds and rotates until it becomes a top-down aerial of Venice's canals and streets curling into a sphere. The two tiny figures remain on the terrace. Slow fade to warm light.

entries.text:
Cinematic photorealistic sci-fi action sequence, moody desaturated color grade, dramatic lighting, hyper-detailed mechanical design, motion blur for speed, 4K film quality.

Scene 1: Wide low-angle tracking shot of a futuristic armored rider in black tactical exosuit on a black-gold angular sci-fi motorcycle, speeding on empty highway, overcast sky.

Scene 2: Close-up transformation shot — motorcycle's rear panels mechanically unfold like wings while riding at high speed, sparks of light on metal joints.

Scene 3: Low-angle hero reveal shot of a sleek black Batmobile-style supercar with scissor/wing doors opening, front LED light strip glowing.

Scene 4: Rear-tracking low-angle shot of two motorcycles riding side by side on the highway, wheels blurred with speed.

Scene 5: Rear pursuit shot of the black supercar driving with glowing taillights, a motorcycle catching up close behind.

Scene 6: Aerial drone top-down shot of a curving highway with the car and motorcycles racing, small flying drone visible above for scale.

Scene 7: Close-up action shot of the car's front wheel with sparks flying off the road surface, high-speed drift feel.

Scene 8: Interior POV shot from the car's dashboard, glowing speedometer, driving fast through a dark tunnel with lights streaking past.

Not natural walking, but exaggerated cartoon tiptoe. Each step: stop, foot forward only, body catches up all at once, head overshoots a bit, recoils back, stops dead. Gaze switches quickly: pudding, right, left, behind, back to pudding. Sudden brake near counter. Hair and sleeves flow forward then back.  8.5~10.5 seconds:  Pudding discovery's big reveal. Both hands on counter, body stretches up for an instant. Switches to touched face, dreamy face, scheming grin. Ends in decisive pose full stop.  10.5~12.5 seconds:  The girl gently lifts the pudding with both hands. Hunches small and focuses before lifting. The next instant, quickly pulls the pudding to her chest. Overshoots backward from momentum, recoils back. Can't contain joy, trembles faintly. Switches to serious face, surprise face, grin, expectant sparkling face. Camera suddenly zooms in. Pudding placed with a spoon. Short stop just before bringing face close to the pudding.  12.5~14.2 seconds:  Biggest reaction to tasting the pudding. The instant the girl takes a spoonful bite, one-frame strong impact pose. Shoulders jolt big, hair and sleeves bounce up. Cute little shockwave-like reaction. Cheeks flush red, presses one hand to cheek. Quickly switches to surprise, touched, happy, satisfied expressions.  14.2~15.0 seconds:  Final decisive pose. One hand pressing cheek, the other holding the plate with the pudding. Eyes narrowed in a happy smile. Body in full stop. Only hair, sleeves, and skirt hem sway softly in the afterglow. Camera zooms in a bit, centering the happy expression. End with a cute, satisfied clincher frame.  Use camera techniques like ultra-wide, quick zoom, low angle, slight Dutch angle, quick pan, short cut-ins. Strongly zoom in on pudding discovery, instant movement, sudden stop, tasting moment. But always keep the positional relationship of the character's face, pudding, and island counter clearly visible.
